title: Settings
privacy: Your data stays only on this phone. Nothing is sent online.

backup.title: Backup
backup.lead: Data lives only on this phone: if you uninstall the app or clear Chrome's data, it is gone. Save a backup every week, for example to Google Drive. The backup contains everything: logs, programs, diet, plan, history, archive and language.
backup.shareHint: "Save to Drive or share" opens the Android menu: pick Drive to keep the backup in the cloud.
backup.saved: Backup file downloaded to the Downloads folder.
backup.shareFailed: Sharing didn't work. Use "Download file" instead.

errors.notBackup: This file isn't a Diario Fitness backup. Pick a .json file exported from this app.
errors.newerVersion: This backup comes from a newer version of the app. Reopen the app with a connection to update it, then try again.
errors.corrupt: The backup file is damaged and can't be read. Try an older backup.

backup.contains: It contains {{programs}} programs, {{diets}} diets, {{history}} history entries, {{archive}} archived versions, {{days}} days, {{workouts}} workouts, {{runs}} runs, {{weeks}} weekly checks and {{months}} monthly checks.
backup.replaceWarning: Everything on this phone will be replaced by the backup. Make a backup of the current data first if you need it.
backup.importPlan: Load plan, programs and diet only
backup.importChoice: "Restore everything" replaces all data on this phone. "Load plan, programs and diet only" keeps your logs and updates profile, programs, diet, plan and history: replaced versions go to the Plan's Archive.
backup.planImported: Plan, programs and diet loaded. Your logs are unchanged; previous versions are in the Archive.
backup.emptyHint: First time here? Restore the backup file you received to load your plan, programs and diet.

install.title: Install on Android
install.step1: Open the app's address in Chrome, with an internet connection.
install.step2: Tap the ⋮ menu, then "Install app" (or "Add to Home screen").
install.step3: Open it from the Home screen icon: from then on it works without internet.

danger.title: Delete data
danger.warning: This permanently deletes everything on this phone. Type {{word}} to confirm.
